stem.text: Let \( f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{x^{2} - 9}{x + 3}, & x < -3 \\ kx + m, & -3 \le x \le 5 \\ 3 x^{2} - 9, & x > 5 \end{cases} \), where k and m are constants. Find the values of k and m for which f is continuous for all real numbers.

answer_key.label: \( k = 9 \) and \( m = 21 \), because the middle branch must equal -6 at \( x = -3 \) and 66 at \( x = 5 \).

worked_solution.text: For \( x < -3 \), \( \frac{x^{2} - 9}{x + 3} = x - 3 \), so the limit from the left at \( x = -3 \) is -6. The middle branch gives \( f(-3) = -3k + m \), so \( -3k + m = -6 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the first boundary

worked_solution.text: At \( x = 5 \) the middle branch gives \( f(5) = 5k + m \) and the last branch approaches 66, so \( 5k + m = 66 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the second boundary

worked_solution.text: Subtracting the equations gives \( k = 9 \), and then \( m = 21 \).

options.label: \( k = 9 \) and \( m = 21 \), because the middle branch must equal -6 at \( x = -3 \) and 66 at \( x = 5 \).
\( k = 6 \) and \( m = 36 \), because the middle branch must equal 18 at \( x = -3 \) and 66 at \( x = 5 \).
options.derivation: at x = -3 the last branch, which applies only for x > 5, used in place of the first branch

options.label: No values of k and m work, because \( \frac{x^{2} - 9}{x + 3} \) is undefined at \( x = -3 \), so f has no limit there.
options.derivation: the first branch is undefined at x = -3, and that was taken to mean its limit there does not exist

options.label: \( k = 1 \) and \( m = -3 \), because the middle branch must equal -6 at \( x = -3 \) and 2 at \( x = 5 \).
options.derivation: at x = 5 the first branch, which applies only for x < -3, used in place of the last branch
